integrity: The upper bound and equality characterization have a direct finite combinatorial proof.
Two exact computational checks independently test the structural bound on small dual orders and directly enumerate the six-vertex hypergraphs.
Independent audit, proof-assistant verification, and expert attestation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to 3-uniform, 2-regular simple hypergraphs and the coefficient counting independent 4-sets.
No coefficient-wise statement for larger set sizes or higher regularity is claimed.
Best-of-knowledge novelty checking cannot exclude unpublished or unindexed prior work.
title: Fourth-coefficient extremizers for 2-regular triple systems
